ideas.pitch: An autonomous multi-agent system designed for college administration that automatically detects, categorizes, and routes infrastructure or student grievances to the correct department using self-improving semantic routing.
ideas.title: CampusIncidentAgent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targets an operational pain point directly felt by the organizing institution, Mahendra Engineering College, making it immediately relatable to the judging panel.

ideas.pitch: A visual workflow orchestration tool for student club event approvals that uses BPMN models to govern autonomous multi-agent execution with human-in-the-loop checkpoints.
ideas.title: BPMNAgentFlow
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates strict enterprise process governance and workflow control, appealing to judges looking for structured, production-ready agentic architectures.

ideas.pitch: An educational reinforcement learning environment where two AI student agents debate complex engineering concepts to find gaps in each other's reasoning and summarize findings for users.
ideas.title: AdversarialStudyGroup
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages advanced multi-agent game theory and self-play mechanics, showcasing deep technical implementation beyond basic API wrappers.

ideas.pitch: An on-device local AI code review agent running on lightweight NPUs to provide privacy-first, zero-latency code quality checks and refactoring suggestions for student programming labs.
ideas.title: OfflineCodeMentor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves the practical hardware and internet connectivity constraints often faced during campus-hosted hackathons while emphasizing hardware acceleration.

ideas.pitch: An autonomous data governance agent that monitors campus database schemas, detects schema drifts or anomalies, validates the fix, and automatically submits pull requests with audit logs.
ideas.title: DataLineageAgent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Implements complex end-to-end data lifecycle tracing with automated verification, satisfying the judging criteria for technical complexity and real-world impact.
